additional_requirements.title: Test validation of all signed artifacts upon uploading to the package registry
additional_requirements.text:
Ensure every artifact in the package registry has been validated with its signature.

1. On GitHub, navigate to a pull request
2. On the pull request, click <> Commits and view the detailed information regarding the signature.

additional_requirements.title: Test validation of signatures for all versions of an existing artifact
additional_requirements.text:
For each artifact, ensure that all of its versions are signed and validated before it is uploaded or used.

additional_requirements.title: Test auditing of changes in package registry configuration
additional_requirements.text:
Verify that all changes to the packages registry configuration are audited.

Search the audit log with

repo category actions

additional_requirements.title: Test securing of repository webhooks
additional_requirements.text: For each webhook in use, ensure it's secured (over HTTPS).
